Description: Allows caster to repair (not replace) one sprain. Requires a one hour operation

Caster acquires complete understanding of any muscle and/or tendon damage, including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive the skill or power necessary to perform the cure
Allows caster to repair 1 damaged muscle. Requires a 1 minute operation. Recovery time is 1 day per muscle repaired
Allows caster to repair 1 damaged tendon. Requires a 1 minute operation. Recovery time is 1 day per tendon repaired
Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed). Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Bone Mastery spell list as well
As Muscle Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged muscles
As Tendon Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged tendons
As Muscle Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3 Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully functional after 10-100 days
As Tendon Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous
Allows caster to repair all tendon and muscle damage in target's body. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days

Allows caster to transplant a healthy muscle into the target. This requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the target's body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as the target, 50% is the bone is from some other similiar race
Allows caster to regenerate 1 muscle. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on extent of loss
Allows caster to regenerate 1 tendon. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on extent of loss
As Muscle Transplant, except recovery time is 1-10 hours
As Muscle Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours
As Tendon Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes
As Muscle Regeneration, except that regrowth takes 10 minutes
As Tendon Regeneration, except that regrowth takes 10 minutes

As Soft Structure Repair, except that all tendons and muscles in target's body are repaired (not replaced). This requires a 10 minute operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. SPECIAL NOTES 1) See Section 7.2 for more on damage and healing. 2) Some spells on this list require an operation to be effective. These spells have the same name as other healing spells (from the Channeling realm) and the GM may decide that the operation is not required. MUSCLE MASTERY
